en.title: How to buy a Chinese bike in Europe: dealers, direct orders and the real cost
en.description: Where to buy Chinese bikes in Europe: ten official brand routes, EU versus UK import questions, and a practical landed-cost comparison.
en.intro: Start with a dealer if you want local sizing and assembly, or compare a direct order when you need a particular frame or finish. The useful question is where this exact bike will be sold, shipped and supported.

sections.heading: Start with the seller, not the flag on the frame
paragraphs: There are three useful starting routes: a listed dealer, confirmed regional stock, and a direct shipment from China. A dealer may offer a fit check and assembled bike. Regional stock can simplify delivery. A factory order may offer more finishes or configuration choices.

Winspace lists dealers in France, Germany, Spain and other European countries; SEKA and PARDUS also publish dealer directories. ICAN has a specific [GRARO EU listing](https://icancycling.com/products/graro-eu). LightCarbon publishes a [manufacturer contact route](https://www.lightcarbon.com/contact-us_d2), rather than a comparable EU checkout. These are different buying processes even though all four frames may appear in the same search results.

Use the ten official links below to find a starting route, then ask where your exact size and finish physically sit. A euro price does not prove EU stock, and a listed dealer may not carry your chosen build. The routes were first researched September 22, 2026; ICAN and LightCarbon links were rechecked September 26.
bullets: [Winspace](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers): Brand shop or listed dealer; ask which warehouse supplies the exact order.
[Elves](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php): Brand or country distributor; get a paint and production quote.
[YOELEO](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery): Global or regional store; warehouse and tax terms depend on the order.
[ICAN](https://icancycling.com/products/graro-eu): The GRARO EU listing is an actual EU frameset route; confirm your size is in that stock before comparing it with China dispatch.

[LightCarbon](https://www.lightcarbon.com/contact-us_d2): Use the manufacturer contact form for an itemized quote; its contact page says it is seeking a new European partner, so verify any claimed regional seller.
[SEKA](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/): Start with the current global dealer directory.
[Tavelo](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer): Brand site and dealer locator; check exact generation and stock.
[PARDUS](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/): Check the global dealer network for your country.
[VeloBuild](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html): Website order followed by written configuration confirmation.
[Dengfu](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/): Direct manufacturer inquiry; confirm model, stock and package.

sections.heading: EU, UK and the rest of Europe need different calculations
paragraphs: If goods are outside the EU when sold, the [European Commission explains](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/importation/buying-goods-online-coming-non-european-union-country_en) that import VAT, possible customs duty and handling charges can affect the delivered cost. Ask which charges the seller has already collected and which the carrier may collect. If the item is already in the EU at sale, the Commission describes a different, simpler customs position for the consumer.

The EU also maintains [anti-dumping measures on certain China-origin bicycles and parts](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2025/2146/oj/eng). A complete bicycle and a frameset need their own classification and quote; do not paste a universal percentage into a budget. Ask the seller for the declared item, origin, import role and the total you are expected to pay.

For the UK, start with its separate [tax and duty guidance](https://www.gov.uk/goods-sent-from-abroad/tax-and-duty); Northern Ireland may need different handling. Switzerland and Norway are also outside the EU. If a seller offers delivered-duty-paid shipping, ask who resolves an unexpected carrier bill and keep that answer with the invoice.

sections.heading: What owner stories can actually tell you
paragraphs: One [June 2025 ICAN GRARO owner](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135) reported that EU stock ran out and a China shipment took roughly four and a half weeks. The transferable question is whether the GRARO EU listing currently has your size, and what changes if it does not.

[Elves buyers in 2025–26](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html) reported quite different waits for their frames. Treat their dated order and dispatch milestones as a reason to ask for a paint-production estimate. Neither thread supplies a reliable delivery rate for a new order.

sections.heading: Put a price on having someone nearby
paragraphs: Request two comparable quotes: the same frame generation, the same cockpit dimensions and the same completed build. Add assembly, any fit changes, missing small parts and payment conversion costs. A local bike that costs more at checkout may be closer to the direct build’s finished cost than its bare-frame price suggests.

PARDUS is a good reason to check the dealer route first: its [global directory](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/) lists European dealers. That does not guarantee stock of the exact Chinese-market build you found. Match the model year and component list, rather than translating the model name and hoping.

Ask where a warranty claim is handled, whether a replacement frame requires international shipping, and who pays to move the components. Also price a spare hanger and confirm how to order the headset parts. The least glamorous pieces can determine whether your bike misses one weekend or several.

sections.heading: Send one clear message before paying
paragraphs: Copy this into a message: “Please quote [exact model/revision], [size], [finish] and [cockpit] to [country and postcode]. Which company will invoice me, where is this configuration physically stocked, and when would it dispatch? List included parts, total payable, import-charge treatment, return address and warranty contact. If regional stock disappears, please ask before changing the shipping origin.”

Save the reply beside both route totals above. If the dealer quote buys a fit check and assembly you value, count those services. If the direct quote still wins, you have a clear order instead of an attractive starting price.

zh-Hans.title: 在欧洲怎么买中国品牌自行车：经销商、直购与落地成本
zh-Hans.description: 欧洲如何购买中国品牌自行车：十个品牌的官方渠道、欧盟与英国不同的进口问题，以及到手成本比较。
zh-Hans.intro: 想要附近车店协助试尺码和装配，可先找经销商；想要特定车架或涂装，再比较品牌直购。关键是这辆车究竟由谁销售、从哪里发货、由谁负责售后。

sections.heading: 先确认卖家，再看车架上的品牌
paragraphs: 可以从三种路线开始：名单内经销商、确认有货的区域仓，以及中国直发。经销商可能提供合身检查和整车装配；区域仓可能简化交付；厂家直购则可能有更多涂装或配置。

Winspace 列有法国、德国、西班牙等国家的经销商；SEKA、PARDUS 也有官方名单。ICAN 有明确的 [GRARO EU 商品页](https://icancycling.com/products/graro-eu)；LightCarbon 则提供[厂家联系渠道](https://www.lightcarbon.com/contact-us_d2)，并非同样的欧盟结算页面。它们出现在相同搜索结果里，买起来却是不同流程。
通过下方十个官方链接找起点，再问准确尺码和涂装的实物在哪里。欧元标价不能证明欧盟现货，列入名单的车店也未必备有目标配置。渠道初查于 2026 年 9 月 22 日，ICAN 与 LightCarbon 链接于 9 月 26 日复核。
bullets: [Winspace](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers): 品牌商城或名单内经销商；确认具体订单的发货仓。
[Elves](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php): 品牌或当地代理；核对涂装与生产报价。
[YOELEO](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery): 全球或区域商城；仓库与税费条件须按订单确认。
[ICAN](https://icancycling.com/products/graro-eu): GRARO EU 是明确的欧盟车架购买路线；确认目标尺码确实在该仓，再与中国发货报价比较。
[LightCarbon](https://www.lightcarbon.com/contact-us_d2): 通过厂家联系页逐项询价；该页称正在寻找新的欧洲合作方，声称为当地代理的卖家需再核实。
[SEKA](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/): 从当前全球经销商名单开始。
[Tavelo](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer): 品牌官网与经销商查询；核对代际和库存。
[PARDUS](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/): 先查全球经销网络是否覆盖所在国家。
[VeloBuild](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html): 网站下单后，书面确认完整配置。
[Dengfu](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/): 直接向厂家询价；确认车型、库存和套餐。

sections.heading: 欧盟、英国及其他欧洲国家要分开计算
paragraphs: 商品在销售时仍位于欧盟之外，[欧盟委员会说明](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/importation/buying-goods-online-coming-non-european-union-country_en)，进口增值税、可能的关税及清关服务费会影响到手成本。问清卖家已代收什么、快递还可能收什么。商品销售时已在欧盟内，则消费者面临的海关环节不同。
欧盟还对部分中国原产自行车及零件维持[反倾销措施](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2025/2146/oj/eng)。整车与车架要按各自商品分类报价，别往预算里贴一个通用百分比。请卖家写明申报商品、原产地、进口责任方及预计由你支付的总额。
英国应查看自己的[税费规则](https://www.gov.uk/goods-sent-from-abroad/tax-and-duty)，北爱尔兰还可能不同。瑞士、挪威也不属于欧盟。卖家提供完税交货时，问若快递再收钱由谁处理，并将答复与发票保存。

rows: 进口增值税、关税、清关费

sections.heading: 车主故事究竟能说明什么
paragraphs: [2025 年 6 月 ICAN GRARO 车主](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135)称欧盟仓缺货后改从中国发，约四周半收到。可迁移的问题是 GRARO EU 页面是否真有你要的尺码，以及缺货时订单怎样变化。
[Elves 买家在 2025—2026 年](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html)报告的等待时间明显不同。可用他们写出的下单与发货节点，提醒自己询问喷漆生产预计日，但不能拿它们当新订单的可靠交期分布。

sections.heading: 把附近有人能帮忙的价值算进去
paragraphs: 拿到两份可比较报价：相同代际车架、相同把组尺寸、相同完成配置。把装配、合身调整、缺少的小配件及支付换汇费用算进去。结算价较高的本地整车，与直购自组的最终成本，可能没有裸车架标价看起来差那么多。
PARDUS 值得先查经销路线：[全球目录](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/)列有欧洲经销商。但这不保证对方有你在中国网站看到的同一配置。应核对年份与部件清单，不能只翻译车型名称。
问清保修在哪里处理、更换车架是否需要跨国运送、移装配件工时由谁承担。另询备用尾钩价格和碗组配件购买方式。最不起眼的小零件，有时决定停骑一个周末还是好几个。

sections.heading: 付款前，把问题一次问清
paragraphs: 可复制这段询价：“请报价 [准确型号／版本]、[尺码]、[涂装]、[把组]，送往 [国家和邮编]。由哪个公司开票？这套配置的实物在哪个仓，预计何时发出？请列明内含部件、总支付额、进口费用处理、退货地址和保修联系人。若区域仓缺货，改变发货地前请先征得同意。”
将答复与上面的两个渠道总额放一起。经销商若提供你重视的试尺码和装配，应计入价值；若直购仍合适，至少买到的是一份清楚订单，而非好看的起始价。
